meta.name: Lantern-Light Tectonic Crucible
meta.description: An ancient crucible catalyst, crafted by the smith-lords of the Under-Sun Manifold within The Grand Crucible of the Tectonic Leviathan. Tempered with glowing lantern vitriol by a secretive Deep-Bore Horologist, this charm projects a dampening field. When hung on a tool socket or placed nearby, it arrests secondary tectonic shockwaves from shattering pristine cinder ore and other delicate strata.
